/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [utility].[DeriveIntersectName] Script Date: 16/05/2019 12:21:04 ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[DeriveIntersectName] ( @id int ) RETURNS nvarchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @result nvarchar(500)
SET @result = ( SELECT COALESCE(SA.DisplayValue, '') + ' / ' + COALESCE(OA.DisplayValue, '') FROM [Intersect] I
left join AssetDetail SA on SA.Object = I.Subject and SA.ObjectID = I.SubjectID left join AssetDetail OA on OA.Object = I.Object and OA.ObjectID = I.ObjectID
left join [Intersect] SI on I.Subject = 'Intersect' and SI.ID = I.SubjectID
WHERE I.ID = @id )
RETURN @result END

/****** Object: UserDefinedFunction [utility].[DeriveIntersectName] Script Date: 16/05/2019 12:21:04 ******/ SET ANSI_NULLS ON GO SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON GO ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[DeriveIntersectName] ( @id int ) RETURNS nvarchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @result nvarchar(500)
SET @result = ( SELECT COALESCE(SA.DisplayValue, SI.Name, '') + ' / ' + COALESCE(OA.DisplayValue, '') FROM [Intersect] I
left join AssetDetail SA on SA.Object = I.Subject and SA.ObjectID = I.SubjectID left join AssetDetail OA on OA.Object = I.Object and OA.ObjectID = I.ObjectID
left join [Intersect] SI on I.Subject = 'Intersect' and SI.ID = I.SubjectID
WHERE I.ID = @id )
RETURN @result END
